title: Black Obelisk of Shalmaneser III erected
summary: Shalmaneser III’s Black Obelisk, naming “Iaua bit Khumri”, Hadad-ezer, and Hazael, is set up at Nimrud.
description: Shalmaneser III’s Black Obelisk, naming “Iaua bit Khumri”, Hadad-ezer, and Hazael, is set up at Nimrud. Event record added from Griffith & White’s Reply to Beckman, Part 2 (section “The Black Obelisk - Jehu”, p. 10).

sorting_basis.note: Tier 2: CFAH Reply to Beckman (Griffith & White, Part 2): 825 BC.

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "A Reply to Beckman’s Defense of Thiele’s Chronology, Part 2: An Objectivist Answer to the Assyrian Synchronisms," OSF preprint v2.10 (2025), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/DT6GX, section “The Black Obelisk - Jehu”, p. 10
chronologies.note: Erected at Nimrud near the end of Shalmaneser III’s reign, during the civil war with his son.
